name: MINIMAL MACHINE
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless minimal techno from phasing loops
description: MINIMAL MACHINE turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into endless minimal techno. Six short loops (a deep kick, soft hats, a rim or clap, a dub chord stab through a ping-pong echo, a sub bass and a small bleep) each run at their own length, so they phase against each other slowly. Every few bars one step or one sound mutates; it evolves without ever jumping. Twelve presets, four knobs that matter: Density, Drift, Filter, Echo.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
